display.mission_label: industrial leak isolation and casualty transfer

assumptions: Reuse the existing authored Q009 camera-search repeat policy within 3600 s with 60 s repeat cooldown and 120 s/3 m failed-contact cooldown; SC11 uses 18 m public-polygon lanes at unchanged AGL, and SC17 coordinator T009 is proposal scope only. Actual evidence, mission closure, reach, installed capabilities, capacity and receiver confirmation remain authoritative; no casualty truth is exposed and detection or rescue success is not guaranteed.

T001/T009 fly clipped parallel lanes over public mapped polygons instead of visiting only their centroids. Lane spacing is an authored search policy, not detection or coverage evidence; captures, inference, hazards, energy, contacts and action results remain authoritative. No casualty truth enters the route.
v0.5 scripted sensing/network/compute and authored, uncalibrated equipment/work models; no vision backend or calibrated rescue physics.

Background support, roads/tracks, widths, accesses and reservations come from the original build inputs and selected pure geometry functions, exported by dev/export_scene_sources.py; sources/sha256 records their exact provenance. No new road, pad or off-scene continuation is invented.

Compact authored incident and deployment rules only. Seed controls sampled positions and headings. Task allowlists still require local observations, beliefs, capability checks, allocation and real action results; no rescue outcome is scripted.

Canonical grid U remains the height source. Unit model scale is retained. Scene-specific professional access limits and source surface names must survive semantic adaptation; a foot tread is not asphalt or vehicle access.

The tank/bund assembly is anchored to the exact RES_TANK centroid [150,135], facing east towards the source approach. The source plane is F(E,N)=6+0.012N-0.008E, so actual support U there is 6.42 m, not the asset manifest's suggested 6.0 m. The tank is 0.15 m above the bund slab along the same source ground normal.

The bund and tank are an intentional parent/child assembly: their footprints overlap because the tank sits inside the bund. Exempt only this explicit parent relation from pair separation. Keep the 4 m east access and all unrelated source clear strips usable; do not exempt arbitrary overlaps.

A single authored facility vulnerability couples the existing profile fire_spread event at 420 s to the tank when actual post-event fire intensity reaches 0.10. It releases 0.12 m3 and creates the linked 0.30 gas-level hazard, once. These are explicit uncalibrated incident parameters, not a chemical identity, certified failure model or scripted rescue result.

hazard-2 starts inactive with actual zero gas release, then changes only when the linked leak is created. The default profile gas value must not be used to display a leak while attr.leak_active=false. The existing fire hazard and later real suppression/isolation results retain their own truth.

The produced bund has a 4 m open gap; it supplies no liquid-retaining capacity. FUTURE_HAZMAT_CONTAINMENT_INTENT_ONLY remains unbuilt metadata. LEAKING shows the produced spill pool, not a breached bund. A063 establishes an exclusion zone and does not seal the tank, drain a pool or guarantee chemical safety.

Only one casualty is authored at RES_CASUALTY_ASSEMBLY. The unchanged full-size medical_point now occupies the existing 70 x 70 m RES_EQUIPMENT reservation, reached through real I_EQUIPMENT/S_EQUIPMENT access. RES_RECEIVING_LOADING and its existing upstream ambulance remain unchanged; no footprint is shrunk, source vehicle relocated, overlapping placement exempted or new reservation invented. The receiver is an authored staffed service, not a claim that the background supplied a hospital. The foot-mobile team still uses the actual source circulation; no crash or factory operation is invented.
S9 shared integration uses existing facility semantics for physical equipment/facilities and G02 placed_humans/pinned_humans for people. No new upstream semantic class is introduced.

The explicit public regional-survey brief contains only map-level search intent. T001/A005 must obtain real local evidence before rescue or hazard tasks are proposed; no casualty or hazard state is seeded into public priors.

display.model_origins declares each new production family origin [0,0,0] in GLB +Y-up metres; state variants share it at unit scale. This preserves authored support contacts and asymmetric equipment without editing source assets.

State display entities are predeclared and selected only from actual equipment, human-carrier, facility-leak and spill-volume truth. Inactive variants retract POSITION; no hidden model is parked away from the incident.

The bund reservation envelope intentionally contains its slab and open east gap. Source-anchor placement checks the actual source reservation/grid and public-road clearances; it does not reject the source access approach merely for entering that slab envelope. Ordinary operators stay outside the conservative bund navigation footprint and use a reachable stand within the declared 40 m isolation range. Parent/child containment is the only placement overlap exemption. Both tank states use the source ground-normal tilt and the 0.15 m local slab-normal child offset.
Hazard sampling is explicitly enabled on this scene’s mobile sensor agents. It uses the existing scripted local A005 range/miss model; SC01/SC03 RGB sensing is unaffected by this extension.

T089/Q089 performs A005/A006/A041/A036 in place, not a flight to the hazard centre. Allocation and A053 use the reported/local platform pose and known hazard position against the existing A005 radius max(1, min(range_m default 250, sensor_range_m default 250)). Out-of-range or unknown positions do not become monitoring success; an in-range assignment still requires actual sensing, interpretation and reporting. Exclusion zones still prohibit actual routes entering them, and no casualty identity or location is inferred from a blocked camera projection.

T031 is enabled for the same casualty because T029 only assesses injury and does not satisfy the aid objective. Treatment still requires C21 and an actual accessible medical_pack; the two existing receiver stock units permit post-arrival care, not remote treatment.
